title: 401(k) Plan Investments: DOL Can Take Steps to Prepare for Expected Private Equity Growth
summary:
What GAO Found

Private equity is one type of investment within a broad, undefined category called alternative assets. It differs from publicly traded equity in who can invest in it, how it is valued, and what disclosures are required, among other things. title: Veteran Lending: Early Planning Is Critical to Assessing VA’s New Foreclosure Avoidance Program
summary:
What GAO Found

The Department of Veterans Affairs’ (VA) Partial Claim Program is intended to help borrowers with VA-guaranteed loans avoid foreclosure. Under this new program, VA reimburses the loan servicer for a borrower’s missed payments and certain fees, allowing the borrower to become current on the loan. title: F-35 Program: DOD Needs to Strengthen Oversight of Tens of Billions of Dollars in Parts
summary:
What GAO Found

The Department of Defense (DOD) continues to face challenges in accounting for F-35 parts, such as engines and tires. The F-35 program includes approximately 26 million F-35 parts, valued at approximately $31 billion and held at over 700 contractor- and government-managed facilities around the world. Although these are DOD-owned parts, DOD does not maintain complete records of the parts.

When children enter or exit foster care, SSA may need to change the payee. title: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office: Patent Backlog Reduction Efforts Pose Risks to Examiner Retention and Examination Quality
summary:
What GAO Found

The backlog of unexamined patent applications awaiting an initial decision from the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) rose to about 838,000 applications in January 2025. In September 2025, the USPTO announced a goal to reduce the backlog to under 599,000 applications but did not specify a time frame for reaching it. The backlog was last at that level in 2020. title: October 28, 2026 letter commenting on the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board's July 2026 Exposure Draft: "Proposed International Standard on Auditing for Audits of Financial Statements of Less Complex Entities (Revised)"
summary: This letter provides GAO's comments on the International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board's (IAASB) Proposed International Standard on Auditing for Audits of Financial Statements of Less Complex Entities (Revised) (ISA for LCE). GAO promulgates generally accepted government auditing standards, which provide professional standards for auditors of government entities in the United States.

title: Professional Standards Update No. 102
summary: To alert the audit community to changes in professional standards, we periodically issue Professional Standards Updates (PSU). These updates highlight the effective dates of recently issued standards and guidance related to engagements conducted in accordance with Government Auditing Standards. PSUs contain summary information only, and those affected by a change should refer to the respective standard or guidance for details.
